===Etymology 1===
{{etymid|en|cord}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₁reyp-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|rop|id=rope}}, {{m|enm|rope}}, from {{inh|en|ang|rāp|t=rope, cord, cable}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*raip}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*raipaz}}, {{m|gem-pro|*raipą|t=rope, cord, band, ringlet}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₁roypnós|t=strap, band, rope}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*h₁reyp-|t=to peel off, tear; border, edge, strip}}.

{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|sco|rape}}, {{m|sco|raip|t=rope}}, {{cog|stq|Roop|t=rope}}, {{cog|fy|reap|t=rope, cord}}, {{cog|nl|roop}}, {{m|nl|reep|t=rope, cord, ring, strip, bar}}, {{cog|nds-de|Reep|t=rope}}, {{cog|de|Reif|t=ring, hoop}}, {{cog|nb,sv|rep|t=rope}}, {{cog|fo,nn|reip|t=rope}}, {{cog|da|reb|t=rope}}, {{cog|is|reipi|t=rope}}, {{cog|sq|rrip|t=belt, rope}}.
{{col-bottom}}

====Alternative forms====
* {{alt|en|roap|roape||all|_|obsolete}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}
[[Image:As de guia 1.jpg|thumb|Length of rope.]]

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} Thick [[string]]s, [[yarn]], [[monofilaments]], metal wires, or [[strand]]s of other [[cordage]] that are twisted together to form a stronger [[line]].
#: {{syn|en|twine|line|cord|Thesaurus:string}}
#: {{ux|en|Nylon '''rope''' is usually stronger than similar rope made of plant fibers.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} An individual [[length]] of such material.
#: {{ux|en|The swinging bridge is constructed of 40 logs and 30 '''ropes'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|All at once, let’s heave on the '''rope'''!}} 
# A cohesive [[strand]] of something.
#: {{ux|en|The duchess wore a '''rope''' of pearls to the soirée.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2003|author=w:Dennis Lehane|title=Mystic River|page=138|url=http://books.google.com/books?id=HQu0fXQ1oXwC|isbn=0688163165
|passage=Jimmy began to scream and '''ropes''' of spit shot from his mouth.}}
# {{lb|en|dated}} A continuous [[stream]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1852|author=John Bourne|title=[http://books.google.com/books?id=bfMOAAAAYAAJ A Treatise on the Screw Propeller: With Various Suggestions of Improvement]|page=38
|passage=The principle of any such device should be to pull on the vessel by a '''rope''' of water passing in at the bow and out at the stern.}}
# {{lb|en|baseball}} A hard [[line drive]].
#: {{ux|en|He hit a '''rope''' past third and into the corner.}}
# {{lb|en|ceramics}} A long thin segment of soft clay, either [[extrude]]d or formed by hand.
# {{lb|en|data structure}} A [[data structure]] resembling a [[string]], using a [[concatenation tree]] in which each [[leaf]] represents a character.
#: {{syn|en|cord}}
# {{lb|en|military|uncountable}} A kind of [[chaff]] {{gloss|material dropped to interfere with radar}} consisting of foil strips with paper chutes attached.
# {{lb|en|Jainism}} A unit of distance equivalent to the distance covered in six months by a god flying at ten million miles per second.
#: {{syn|en|rajju|infinitude}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2001|editor=Nagendra Kr. Singh|chapter=Review of Metaphysical Teaching|title=Encyclopaedia of Jainism|url=http://books.google.com/books?id=Tbpwy5kjJM0C|isbn=8126106913|page=7522
|passage=The central strip of the ''loka'', the Middle World, represents its smallest area, being only one '''rope''' wide and one hundred thousand leagues high, {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|jewelry}} A [[necklace]] of at least one meter in length.
# {{lb|en|nautical}} [[cordage|Cordage]] of at least one [[inch]] in diameter, or a length of such cordage.
# {{lb|en|archaic}} A unit of [[length]] equal to twenty [[feet]].
# {{lb|en|slang}} [[Rohypnol]].
# {{lb|en|slang|usually|in plural}} [[semen|Semen]] being [[ejaculate]]d.
#: {{ux|en|shooting '''ropes'''}}
# {{lb|en|with "the"}} [[Death]] by [[hanging]].
#: {{ux|en|The murderer was sentenced to the '''rope'''.}}
# {{lb|en|rhythmic gymnastics|countable}} An [[apparatus]], currently with [[limited]] use by the [[senior]] [[contestant]]s and not used in [[world-wide]] [[tournament]]s.
## {{lb|en|rhythmic gymnastics|metonymically}} An [[apparatus program]] with a rope.

===Etymology 2===
{{etymid|en|to tie with ropes}}
From {{inh|en|enm|ropen|id=to form ropes}}, {{m|enm|rope|t=to form ropes}}, from {{m|enm|rop|t=rope}}; see above.

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To tie (something) with rope.
#: {{ux|en|The robber '''roped''' the victims.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To throw a rope (or something similar, e.g. a lasso, cable, wire, etc.) around (something).
#: {{ux|en|The cowboy '''roped''' the calf.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To climb by means of a rope or ropes.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1984|author=G. F. Dutton|title=The Ridiculous Mountains|page=153
|passage=We '''roped''' down to the platform selected for the bivouac; set up our bags and brewed a reasonable meal.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be formed into rope; to draw out or extend into a filament or thread.
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 5|III|v|passage=Let us not hang like '''roping''' icicles / Upon our houses' thatch.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To pull or restrain (the horse one is riding) to prevent it from winning a race.
# {{lb|en|[[manosphere]]|[[PSL]]|[[black pill]]|originally|_|incel slang|intransitive}} To [[commit suicide]], particularly after a [[ropefuel]] incident.
#: {{ux|en|My life is a mess; I might as well '''rope'''.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|year=2019|quotee=anonymous|author=Julia Rose DeCook|title=Curating the Future: The Sustainability Practices of Online Hate Groups|site=w:Michigan State University|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210905020033/https://d.lib.msu.edu/etd/47964/datastream/OBJ/view|page=153|passage=
In figure 71, the poster Brahcel notes that he “almost '''roped'''” because he could not find the community {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-web|en|date=2020-04-26|author=Joshua A. Segalewitz|title='You Don't Understand... It's Not About Virginity': Sexual Markets, Identity Construction, and Violent Masculinity on an Incel Forum Board|site=w:University of Dayton|url=https://ecommons.udayton.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1279&context=uhp_theses|page=36|passage=
ToxicAlcoholSyndrome explains that his, “dreams are all really depressing and vivid, so… I’m constantly in a bad mood and know in the back of my brain, I need to '''rope'''.”|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230813170106/https://ecommons.udayton.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1279&context=uhp_theses}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2021|author=Laura Bates|title=From Incels to Pickup Artists: The Truth about Extreme Misogyny and How it Affects Us All|pageurl=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Men_Who_Hate_Women/TLMPEAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22roped%22+%22incel%22&pg=PT65|page=unnumbered
|passage=Another man wrote that the only reason he hasn't “'''roped'''” (incel terminology for death by suicide) is he didn't want to ruin his family's Christmas.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}

===Etymology 3===
{{etymid|en|intestines}}
From {{inh|en|enm|rop|t=gut, intestine|id=gut}}, from {{inh|en|ang|rop}}, {{m|ang|ropp}}; compare {{cog|dum|rop}}, {{m|dum|roppe|t=fish guts}}.

The modern pronunciation results from phonological assimilation to Etymology 1.
